messages:
marta: Following up on the KV-cache OOM postmortem. Goal: define owners, quick experiments, and a tight canary validation matrix so SRE can gate safely.

kevin: I ran a short prod-replay and saw fragmentation spike correlated with a surge of tiny allocations from the transform_worker. heap diff: https://redwood/s/INC-2140/heapdiff.html

alyssa: proposing a minimum safe set of actions so we can iterate fast: profiling, small GC tweak, admission/soft-evict, compact task, and a narrow canary with explicit rollback gates.

marta: ACTION ITEMS (concise):
- 1) Deep profiling (owner: kevin) — replicates on staging, produce pprof cpu+alloc and flamegraphs, attach to INC-2140. due: 2026-03-31
- 2) GC probe (owner: alyssa) — trial GOGC=180 and runtime.SetGCPercent(180) toggled via feature flag; measure heaplive, pause time, and p99 latency. PR + canary. due: 2026-04-01
- 3) Soft admission + metric (owner: diego) — implement kv.soft_limit_pct and emit kv_soft_rejects_total and kv_pool_pressure gauge. include opt-in config. due: 2026-04-02
- 4) Tiny-object compactor (owner: kevin) — background compaction every 4h targeted at small objects; expose kv_compaction_runs. due: 2026-04-05
- 5) Canary & SRE gates (owner: marta) — staged canary 2% -> 8% with auto-rollback on error_rate>0.6% OR kv_fragmentation_ratio>0.78 OR p99 latency +60ms. due: 2026-03-30
- 6) Recurring pattern ticket & review (owner: marta) — create INF-3701 for weekly checks and long-term mitigation tracking. due: 2026-04-07

kevin: quick profiling commands I ran:```GOMAXPROCS=4 ./server --replay=short-prod
sudo perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 20
pprof --text server.alloc > /tmp/alloc.txt
```

alyssa: GC probe plan: feature-flag runtime.SetGCPercent(180) so we can toggle without re-deploying the code path. will include pause & heap charts in PR.

diego: soft admission config sketch:```kv.cache.max_entries=45M
kv.soft_limit_pct=78
kv.soft_reject_behavior=evict_tail
``` I'll open PR INF-3722-PR1 and include a short README for oncall validation.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary-kv-softcap by @diego at 1867201400 — route 2% | sha: f9b1c2a

marta: SRE: please watch error_rate, p99 latency, and kv_fragmentation_ratio. SRE gate: pause expansion if any gate breached; we'll roll back immediately.

kevin: flamegraphs uploaded: https://redwood/s/INC-2140/flamegraphs.zip — top contributor: transform_worker.processBatch -> bytes accumulation in slice growth. short-term mitigation: object reuse or pooling.

alyssa: small suggestion: before altering limits, try a one-off compaction run during a low-traffic window; compaction reduced frag ~9% in microbench. I'll add a compaction-run endpoint for manual triggering.

diego: PR opened: https://redwood/pull/INF-3722-PR1 (soft admission + metrics + README). will start canary now.

infra-bot: notice: canary policy updated by @marta at 1867201425 — route 2% | rollback_on: error_rate>0.6% | kv_fragmentation_ratio>0.78 | p99_latency_delta>60ms

infra-bot: alert: kv_fragmentation_ratio exceeded 0.79 on prod-2 at 1867201490 — SRE paging threshold.

marta: halting canary expansion. SRE, please confirm whether this correlates with canary traffic or background ramp.

kevin: rolling canary back to 0% pending SRE review: `deploy --tag canary-kv-softcap --route=0%`

infra-bot: deploy updated: canary-kv-softcap route 0% at 1867201510 by @diego

diego: will add prometheus alerts for kv_pool_pressure and a Grafana panel for short-lived alloc rate so the oncall has quick signals.

marta: I'll update INC-2140 timeline and create INF-3701 for weekly follow-ups. scheduling a 20m review tomorrow to decide next constrained canary. If anyone needs to reassign, ping me here. Thanks all.

kevin: will proceed with object-pooling patch and share perf numbers.

alyssa: will prepare GC probe PR with toggle and expected validation graphs.

diego: will add README with steps for validating soft-admit behavior during canary (alloc rate, evict counts, miss rate).

marta: closing this async thread; will run the first weekly review in one week.
